text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian successfully outruns two of the strongest racers for a spectacular spring Tenno Sho win, sending the racecourse into a frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her heart races at the prospect of meeting powerful opponents in the senior year, where she can aim at even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen urges her to enter the autumn Tenno Sho, the first race of the Senior Autumn Triple Crown.
